## [Overview](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/slack-integration\#overview)

The Jack & Jill Slack integration lets Jill send role updates and candidate activity to your hiring team in Slack. Setup has two parts:

1. Connect Jill to your company’s Slack workspace.
2. Connect each role to its own Slack channel.

Once a role is connected, Jill can post updates in that role’s Slack channel. You can keep email notifications on too, or use Slack as the main notification path.

## [Before you start](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/slack-integration\#before-you-start)

You need:

- A Jill company admin account.
- Permission to install apps in your Slack workspace.
- Access to the Jill role you want to connect to Slack.

Installing Jill’s Slack app requires approval from a Slack workspace admin.

## [Connect your Slack workspace](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/slack-integration\#connect-your-slack-workspace)

1. Open Jill.
2. Go to **Integrations** -\> **Slack**.
3. Click **Add to Slack**.
4. Review the Slack permissions and approve the install.
5. After Slack sends you back to Jill, check that your Slack workspace appears on the Slack integration page.

If you are not a company admin in Jill, ask a company admin to connect Slack first. Once Slack is connected, you can link your own Slack account.

If the Slack page shows **Update** on the workspace card later, re-install Jill’s Slack app. This refreshes Jill’s Slack permissions, workspace settings, and member list.

## [Match Jill users to Slack users](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/slack-integration\#match-jill-users-to-slack-users)

Jill needs to know which Slack user matches each Jill teammate.

By default, Jill uses **Match by verified email**. If someone uses the same email address in Jill and Slack, Jill links them automatically.

On the Slack integration page, company admins can:

- View **Active Jill users**.
- View **Connected Slack users**.
- Turn **Match by verified email** on or off.

Keep **Match by verified email** on unless your team uses different email addresses in Jill and Slack, or you want each teammate to link their Slack account manually.

## [Link your own Slack account](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/slack-integration\#link-your-own-slack-account)

If Jill has not matched your Slack account automatically:

1. Go to **Integrations** -\> **Slack**.
2. In **Your Slack account**, click **Connect my Slack account**.
3. Sign in with Slack.
4. Return to Jill and check that your account is connected.

Use **Reconnect my Slack account** if your Slack email changes. Use **Unlink** if you connected the wrong account.

## [Connect a role to Slack](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/slack-integration\#connect-a-role-to-slack)

Each Jill role uses its own Slack channel.

1. Open the role you want to connect.
2. Open **Configure Role** -\> **Notifications**.
3. In the **Slack** row, click **Choose a channel**.
4. Choose a channel name. Jill suggests a name like `#jill-vp-finance-and-strategic-operations`.
5. Click **Connect**.

Jill creates a private Slack channel for the role, or connects to an existing channel if you confirm that is what you want. She also invites matched role teammates where possible.

After the channel connects, Jill turns Slack alerts on for that role. If the Slack row still says **Off**, switch it **On**.

## [Create channels automatically](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/slack-integration\#create-channels-automatically)

Instead of connecting each role by hand, a company admin can have Jill create a channel for every new role.

1. Go to **Integrations** -\> **Slack**.
2. Turn on **Auto-create Slack channels**.

From then on, when a role starts hiring, Jill creates its private channel and invites matched role teammates, as in [Connect a role to Slack](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/slack-integration#connect-a-role-to-slack). This also applies to roles created by an ATS integration, such as [roles created from a custom ATS](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/custom-ats-integration#5-create-roles-from-your-ats-optional). Roles that are already active do not get a channel retroactively.

This setting is on while Slack role updates are on. To turn it off, turn off Slack role updates in your organization settings first.

## [Managing notifications](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/slack-integration\#managing-notifications)

Open **Configure Role** -\> **Notifications** to choose how Jill sends role updates.

You can:

- Send role updates to Slack.
- Send role updates by email.
- Keep both paths on.
- Choose the notification schedule.
- Choose who receives email role updates. Introduction recipients are set under **Configure Role → Intro emails**.

For role updates, Jill requires at least one notification path to stay on. If Slack is your only active path for role updates, turn email back on before turning Slack off.

## [Troubleshooting](https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs/slack-integration\#troubleshooting)

**I see “Slack is not connected yet”.** No one has linked your company’s Slack workspace yet. Ask a Jill company admin to go to **Integrations** -\> **Slack** and click **Add to Slack**. Once that’s done, you can connect your own account.

**Slack says I need a workspace admin.** Installing the Jill app requires a Slack workspace admin — even if you’re a Jill admin. Ask your Slack admin to approve the install, or have them complete **Add to Slack** on your behalf.

**A teammate isn’t connected to Slack.** Check whether their Jill email matches their Slack email — with **Match by verified email** on, Jill links them automatically when the addresses match. If they use different emails, ask them to go to **Integrations** -\> **Slack** and click **Connect my Slack account**.

**Slack says the channel already exists.** You picked a name that’s already in your workspace. If that channel isn’t linked to another Jill role, Jill will ask you to confirm — go ahead and use it. Otherwise, pick a different name.

**The channel is already linked to another Jill role.** Each role gets its own channel, and a Slack channel can only belong to one role. Go back and choose a different channel name.

**Jill can’t connect to an existing channel.** Jill needs to be a member of the channel before she can post there. In Slack, invite the Jill app to the channel and try again. Or pick a new channel name and let Jill create a private one for the role.
